title: Wants to control your phone or screen
why: Remote-access apps let a stranger see your screen and OTPs and move money while you watch. Bank and refund staff never ask for them.
examples: To process your refund, install AnyDesk and tell me the 9 digit code.
Download TeamViewer QuickSupport and share your ID so I can fix the payment.
safe: Our IT team will help you with your laptop setup on Monday.
Screen time report for this week: 4 hours daily.
